[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. **Mango Cucumber Chili Refresher**: Muddle cucumber and jalapeño, then add 2 oz gin, 1 oz mango puree, 1 oz lime juice, and 1/2 oz simple syrup.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. **Mango Ginger Fizz**: Shake 2 oz rum, 1 oz mango puree, 1 oz ginger liqueur, and 1 oz lime juice.
